from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalCase(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document regarding its title and cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the case, e.g., execution, civil, criminal")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    legal_cases: list[LegalCase]
